skill.name: Chapter Analyzer
skill.description: Validates and analyzes Docusaurus MDX chapters for structure, pedagogical quality, and component usage.
skill.summary: Reviews Docusaurus MDX chapters for frontmatter, structure, learning flow, interactive components, and tone.
skill.author: AbdulSamad94

security_audit.summary: The static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown code spans and a YAML example in SKILL.md. I found no command execution, reconnaissance behavior, prompt injection, or other malicious intent in the single reviewed file.

The backticks wrap an MDX simulation component example. This is documentation of expected chapter markup, not process execution.

content.value_statement: Docusaurus course chapters often drift in structure, tone, and learning flow. This skill reviews MDX chapters against clear documentation and teaching rules.
actual_capabilities: Checks that chapters target Docusaurus MDX or Markdown files under textbook/docs.
Reviews YAML frontmatter expectations for id, title, sidebar label, and description.
Evaluates heading hierarchy so body content starts below the Docusaurus page title.
Assesses pedagogical flow from introduction through objectives, core content, interaction, and summary.
Checks expected MDX component usage for quizzes, simulations, and tabbed examples.
Reviews tone for accessible, encouraging, and clear technical writing.
limitations: It describes review criteria but does not include an automated parser.
It focuses on Docusaurus course chapters, not general website documentation.
It cannot verify whether custom MDX components compile in a specific project.
It does not define grading rubrics beyond the listed structure and tone checks.

use_cases.title: Review a New Lesson
use_cases.description: Check a draft chapter before it enters a Docusaurus textbook.

use_cases.title: Standardize Existing Chapters
use_cases.description: Compare older chapters against one shared structure and teaching pattern.

use_cases.title: Prepare Educational Content
use_cases.description: Confirm that technical lessons include objectives, interaction, summaries, and accessible explanations.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Chapter Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Docusaurus MDX chapter with the Chapter Analyzer skill. Tell me whether it follows the expected structure and tone.

prompt_templates.title: Frontmatter and Heading Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this chapter for valid frontmatter, heading hierarchy, and body structure. List the issues in priority order.

prompt_templates.title: Learning Flow Assessment
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this chapter for introduction quality, learning objectives, core explanations, interactive elements, and summary coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Full Editorial Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a complete Chapter Analyzer audit across structure, MDX components, learning flow, and clarity. Recommend specific edits for publication readiness.

output_examples.input: A Docusaurus chapter with frontmatter, several headings, and one quiz section.
output_examples.output: The chapter follows the expected page structure. Add clearer learning objectives and expand the final summary before publication.

output_examples.input: A draft chapter that starts with a body title and contains no interactive element.
output_examples.output: The chapter needs structural revision. Remove the extra body title, start with second-level sections, and add a quiz or simulation.

output_examples.input: A technical tutorial with unexplained terms and tabbed code examples.
output_examples.output: The component usage fits the expected pattern. Define specialized terms earlier so the tone remains accessible.

best_practices: Provide the full chapter text so structure, flow, and tone can be reviewed together.
Ask for separate checks when you only need frontmatter, headings, or learning flow feedback.
Use the findings as editorial guidance and verify MDX compilation in your Docusaurus project.
anti_patterns: Do not use it as a replacement for a Docusaurus build or lint step.
Do not apply its rules to unrelated documentation formats without adapting the criteria.
Do not ask it to approve content without reviewing the actual chapter text.

faq.question: What type of files does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews Docusaurus MDX and Markdown chapters, especially files intended for textbook/docs.

faq.question: Does it edit files automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill defines analysis criteria and can guide edits, but it does not include automation.

faq.question: Can it check frontmatter?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks for expected fields such as id, title, sidebar label, and description.

faq.question: Can it review teaching quality?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews objectives, explanations, interactions, summaries, and clarity.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks the skill as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I verify outside this skill?
faq.answer: Run your Docusaurus build and test custom MDX components in the target project.
